name: Shafts, Bearings, Couplings & Seals
summary: Designing rotating assemblies: shafts and their connections, rolling and sliding bearings, lubrication, couplings, seals and linear guides.

topics.name: Shaft design for stress (static and fatigue) and deflection
Keys, keyways, splines, set screws and pins
Press and shrink fits; retaining rings
Couplings: rigid, flexible, universal joints and constant-velocity joints
Rolling-element bearings: types, load ratings and L10 life
Bearing selection: combined loads, reliability, preload and mounting
Hydrodynamic journal bearings (Petroff, Sommerfeld number, Raimondi-Boyd charts)
Seals: gaskets, O-rings, lip seals and mechanical face seals
